body.title: Google Meet vag-cccc-ddd
body.notes:
## Summary
The meeting covered the partner portal, data export, and new-hire job description, along with a staging-server update. The group agreed to keep the export in CSV for version one; the estimate and response to the auditors remain unassigned.

## Key points
- The portal design is done. Segun will build the login screens, and the dashboard is expected in the coming weeks, with no firm date.
- Ebuka will write the data-export spec. Work will need an estimate afterward, but capacity is unknown.
- The auditors asked for the export format soon.
- HR wants the new-hire job description signed off sometime next quarter. Priya will review it but did not commit to a date.
- Segun said he will update the staging server tonight.

## Decisions
- Keep the data export in CSV for version one; Excel can wait.
- Leave the work estimate unassigned for now.
- The dashboard has no firm date; the target is the coming weeks.

## Action items
- Segun: Build the portal login screens (tomorrow).
- Segun: Deliver the portal dashboard (in the coming weeks).
- Ebuka: Write the data-export spec (by next Monday).
- Unassigned: Estimate the data-export work (no due date stated).
- Unassigned: Reply to the auditors about the export format (no due date stated).
- Priya: Review the new-hire job description (no due date stated).
- Segun: Update the staging server (tonight).

## Open questions
- Who has capacity to estimate the export work?
- Who will pick up the export and reply to the auditors?
- Who will sign off on the job description?

## Please check
None noted

body.transcript:
[Priya]: Let's get going. Three things: the partner portal, the data export, and the new hire.
[Segun]: Portal first. Design is done. I will build the login screens tomorrow and have the dashboard in the coming weeks.
[Priya]: Fine. The dashboard has no firm date, so let's say in the coming weeks.
[Ebuka]: For the data export, I will write the spec by next Monday. After that someone has to estimate the work, but we do not know who has capacity.
[Priya]: Agreed, leave the estimate unassigned for now.
[Segun]: The auditors asked for the export format soon. Whoever picks it up should reply to them.
[Priya]: Nobody volunteers, so it stays open.
[Ebuka]: New hire. HR wants the job description signed off sometime next quarter, no rush.
[Priya]: I'll review the job description at some point, but I will not commit to a date.
[Segun]: Also I will update the staging server tonight.
[Priya]: Good. We decided to keep the export in CSV for version one.
[Ebuka]: Agreed. Excel can wait.
[Priya]: Thanks all.
